comments.body: It looks like this has a new recipe. R12 cooking: Deep-fried Fish and Potatoes. Calls for Mustard x1, Fried Fish x1, Frites x1. Frites are made through the Simple Recipes cookbook from Palma, I'm told. I don't know what it makes, but I have a guess: fish and chips.
